title: 138. Minimum Interval to Include Each Query

examples.explanation: The smallest covering intervals are [2,4], [2,4], [4,4], and [3,6].

Query 2 is covered by [2,3] (size 2), [2,5] (size 4), and [1,8] (size 8) — smallest is [2,3] size 2. Query 19 has no covering interval, so -1. Query 5 is covered by [2,5] (size 4) and [1,8] (size 8) — smallest is [2,5] size 4. Query 22 is covered only by [20,25] (size 6).
Query 1 is covered by [1,1] (size 1). Query 2 has no covering interval, so -1.

hints: Process queries in sorted order while separately preserving each query's original index.
Before answering query q, add every interval whose left endpoint is at most q to a min-heap ordered by interval size.
Remove heap entries whose right endpoint is less than q; the remaining smallest entry gives the answer.
